summary: Chloride supports fluid and acid-base balance, muscle and nervous-system activity, and fluid transport.

functions.title: Source-backed explanation
functions.description: Chloride supports fluid and acid-base balance, muscle and nervous-system activity, and fluid transport.

foodSourceRules.notes: Qualitative source education only. Missing measurements and fatty-acid totals are not reconstructed from other concepts.

absorptionFactors.description: EFSA describes efficient chloride absorption and kidney excretion linked to sodium and potassium balance; no individual absorption percentage is supplied.

deficiency.overview: EFSA describes dietary chloride deficiency as rare in its assessed context. This does not interpret blood chloride or diagnose symptoms.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: The retained EFSA reference opinion does not establish an individual chloride ceiling here; numeric reference values remain unavailable pending separate framework validation.
excess.medicalBoundary: No upper limit is an intake goal. Individual clinical or medical assessment requires a qualified professional.

claims.text: Chloride supports fluid and acid-base balance, muscle and nervous-system activity, and fluid transport.

claims.limitations: EFSA derived chloride reference values from sodium on an equimolar basis because direct evidence was insufficient. No equal-mass conversion or numeric framework row is inferred.
